items.title: Rico Dowdle: Spectator for Tuesday's practice
items.description:

items.title: Jayden Daniels: Could need surgery after season
items.description:
Daniels will avoid a procedure on his dislocated left elbow for the time being, but Adam Schefter of ESPN reports that the quarterback could undergo surgery after the season.
